svg.title: Dreams progress by system and component
svg.desc: Every function square is the same size. Every system and component has a visible name and checked-versus-mapped count. Green means name checked; amber means review unresolved; gray means unreviewed. Blank space is layout space, not progress. Full system sizes remain unknown.

g.text: 1,540 functions mapped to Dreams systems | 27 names checked
Each square is one function. Counts show checked names / identified functions.
8,011 functions still need system mapping. Full system sizes and completion remain unknown.
Squares are comparable across all groups. Box space is reserved for labels; box area does not measure system size.
